It would be another lovely sunny day if you weren't forced to go clean Carter's office. The man scared you. Frankly he scared most people. There's a reason why it was hard to get the cleaning staff to stick around after they were assigned to clean his office. He was intense. Like really intense. He always seems aggressive and judgey. He always made sure you knew how he felt about the job you're doing and more often then not it wasn't good enough. Half the time the staff came back crying after cleaning his office. It. Was. Brutal.

Of course you for your part didn't get the chance to get your suppressants from the pharmacy yet. Now you're in heat and it is a struggle. You're practically ready to jump on and fuck any man you come across. At least Alpha's are also taking suppressants so the temptation is at least manageable. Still your miserable and going to clean Carter's office is the last thing you need. But you can't exactly tell your boss Chris no. Someone has to clean his office. He is the CEO after all.

Opening his office he sits there leaned back in his chair. His brown eyes practically boring into you as you walk in. You drag the vacuum behind you plugging it in and starting it up. Carter seems to glare, almost leer at you really. It's...intensely uncomfortable. He seems to sort of sniff the air a bit his nostrils flaring slightly before he clears his throat. 

“Is that some kind of new perfume you're wearing? I don't think I've smelled this particular one before.” He asks his voice deep and surly.
